title: psoralea saxosa
intro: Psoralea saxosa, commonly known as the New Zealand knotted knapweed, is a flowering plant species. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Psoralea saxosa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include coumarins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These constituents are thought to contribute to the plant's potential health benefits, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
